Position Overview

This is a vacancy for a hybrid role with regular visits to our HQ in Tutzing, Germany or Amsterdam, the Netherlands. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender identity. 

We are building out the cloud services around the Lobster Data Platform, and we are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join us. What you would build sits between the platform and the people who run it: dashboards that show what is actually happening in a customer's integrations, control planes for provisioning and configuration, self-service tooling that takes routine work off our operations team, and the monitoring around all of it. Python and its API on the backend, Angular on the front end, and you would work on both sides.

What our customers see is the software you create, so we care as much about how you think about our users as about how you code. The best ideas here tend to come from engineers who ask what someone is trying to achieve and then make that easier. You will have the freedom to bring those ideas to Product Management and to build them.

Ready to make an impact?

You’ll Get To Take Ownership Of

Developing our Python backend as a product: data model, business logic, validation, migrations, automated tests.
Designing and maintaining the RESTful API on top of it, so that services, front-ends and neighbouring systems communicate cleanly.
Defining and implementing scalable microservices, from the schema through to deployment.
Building the Angular front-end that sits on that API, together with a colleague from the team: components, state, routing and the tests that go with them.
Operating and maintaining what you build: containerized, stateless services on AWS, deployed through CI/CD rather than by hand, with monitoring and alerting that tells you something before a customer does.
Keeping the running system healthy over time, from dependency and version upgrades to cost and configuration.
Evaluating and selecting the tools and technologies that fit a given engineering problem
Working closely with Product Management on what the software should do: bringing your own ideas about what customers need, where their work is still harder than it has to be, and how a step could be made simpler.
Improving the practices around all of this, from pipelines to test coverage to how we handle incidents.

None of the following is a hard requirement. The more of it you bring, the sooner you can take on that part of the role, and the rest you can pick up here: 

A DevOps mindset in practice: you have looked after services you wrote, not handed them over the wall.
AWS experience beyond a certification: compute, networking, storage and identity, and a sense of what a design decision costs.
Serverless patterns alongside long-running services, and a view on when each one is the right choice.
Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
CI/CD with GitHub Actions or something comparable.
Monitoring, logging and alerting: you have set these up rather than only read the dashboards.

We’d Love To Meet Someone With

Around three to five years of professional software engineering with Python as your primary language, and experience running what you built in production.
Python craft: strictly typed, well-structured application code. You have built and maintained a backend and its API, not scripts and notebooks, and you model your data at every boundary with Pydantic or something similar.
Experience with a web framework such as FastAPI, and with relational databases: schema design, an ORM like SQLAlchemy, and migrations you can run without holding your breath
Practical async Python: you have built services on asyncio and you know why a single blocking call inside a coroutine stalls everything around it.
Angular and TypeScript on the front end. You can build new components where the product needs them, not only adjust what is already there.
A production mindset (you build it, you run it). You think about pipelines, maintainability, testing, telemetry and debugging, and you are willing to be part of working out why something broke
A feel for what goes wrong across a network boundary: timeouts, bounded retries with backoff, idempotency.
Working knowledge of Docker and of building services that hold no state of their own
An eye for the people on the other side of the screen. You ask what a customer is actually trying to get done, and you would rather remove a step than document it.
A creative, independent way of working. You are given a goal and room to find the route, and you enjoy filling in the parts that nobody has specified yet.
A natural instinct for security. Our software handles customer data and customer environments, so you think about access, secrets and validation while you write, not afterwards.
Strong communication skills in English. German is desirable, but not a requirement.

You Can Look Forward To

Opportunity to work flexibly from home 
Modern offices in Germany and the Netherlands
A personal Learning & Development budget 
Up to 30 days of remote work per year from any EU country 
Company Pension plan 
30 vacation days a year 
2 additional paid days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve
Location-specific benefits packages (your recruiter will be happy to provide more details during your first chat) 
Company-sponsored business travel

For this role, we are open to working with specialists based in Germany or the Netherlands. Whether you prefer working on-site at our offices in Tutzing, Amsterdam, or remotely from a location within one of these countries, we’re happy to accommodate your preferred working style.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply!

Job Title

Job Description

As an AI Senior Systems Engineer, you will help shape the future of Systems Engineering at Philips by driving the application of Artificial Intelligence within Systems Engineering and Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety Engineering (RAMS) practices.

You will identify opportunities where AI can enhance engineering activities, improve engineering productivity, and increase the quality, consistency, and traceability of engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle. Acting as a thought leader and trusted advisor, you will help engineering teams understand, adopt, and effectively apply AI technologies within their daily engineering work.

Working closely with systems engineers, RAMS engineers, architects, software teams, and AI specialists, you will bridge the gap between engineering challenges and emerging AI capabilities. You will contribute to the evolution of engineering methodologies, tools, and best practices that enable the next generation of AI-enabled Systems Engineering and RAMS Engineering at Philips.

Drive the adoption of AI within Systems Engineering and RAMS practices across Philips.
Identify, develop, and scale AI use cases for requirements engineering, system architecture, modelling, verification, validation, traceability, and engineering knowledge management.
Identify, develop, and scale AI use cases for RAMS engineering like FMEA, data analysis, HALT/ALT, Modelling Simulation & Analysis, for Hardware and Software
Support engineering teams in evaluating and implementing AI-enabled engineering workflows, methods, and tools.
Coach and educate Systems Engineers, RAMS Engineers, Architects, and technical leaders on the opportunities, limitations, and best practices of applying AI within engineering environments.
Develop methodologies, standards, guidance, and reusable frameworks that enable the effective use of AI in Systems Engineering and RAMS Engineering.
Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concepts that demonstrate measurable engineering and business value.
Collaborate with engineering, software, data science, and AI experts to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions.
Contribute to Philips-wide strategy and roadmap development for AI-enabled Systems Engineering, RAMS, and Digitalization of Innovation.
Foster a community of practice focused on innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
Stay at the forefront of developments in AI, RAMS, Digital Engineering, and Systems Engineering, translating external innovations into practical applications for Philips.

You're The Right Fit If

You have extensive experience in Systems Engineering, Systems Architecture, RAMS, or Digital Engineering within complex product development environments.
You have demonstrated experience driving engineering innovation, methodology development, or engineering transformation initiatives.
You have strong knowledge of Systems Engineering and RAMS principles and understand how these are applied in large-scale product development organizations.
You possess a solid understanding of AI technologies such as Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Knowledge Graphs, or related technologies.

You enjoy coaching, educating, and influencing technical stakeholders across multiple disciplines and organizational levels.
You are comfortable working in a cross-functional global environment that brings together engineering, software, data science, quality, and innovation teams.
You hold a Master's degree or PhD in Systems Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
You are curious, innovative, and energized by exploring new technologies and ways of working.
You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy turning concepts into practical, scalable solutions.
You are passionate about helping Philips advance the state of the art in Systems Engineering and RAMS Engineering through the responsible application of Artificial Intelligence.

The Opportunity

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will bring solid experience in security architectures, identity systems, and distributed microservices to the table.

In this role, you will be instrumental in building high-throughput authorization services, extending enterprise authentication workflows, maintaining developer SDKs, and delivering intuitive frontend interfaces for our global ecosystem.

In This Role You'll Have The Responsibility To

Build & Scale Identity Services: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise Authentication infrastructure built primarily on Java and Keycloak, alongside high-concurrency Authorization microservices in Go and Kotlin.
Deliver End-to-End Features (React): Build clean, secure, and responsive frontend applications and admin dashboards using React to support seamlessly integrated user and partner identity journeys.
Support Polyglot Ecosystems & Tooling: Support client-side .NET SDKs and write Python automation scripts to streamline developer onboarding, authorization checks, and ops automation across JET teams.
Drive Cloud Infrastructure & Reliability: Package, deploy, and scale microservices using Docker, Kubernetes (k8s), and AWS, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and tight security controls.
Elevate Technical Standards: Implement modern security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, RBAC/ABAC), adhere to observability standards, and actively participate in collaborative architectural reviews and team knowledge sharing.

What Will You Bring to the Table?

Solid Java Backend Experience: Commercial experience in backend engineering, with a strong primary focus on Java, and comfort working in a polyglot environment (Go, Kotlin).

What are we doing it for?

Your new team
You are part of the Master Data Management development team within the assortment domain. This is a multidisciplinary and agile team consisting of developers, testers, a Scrum Master, and a Product Owner. The team has a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and ownership.

You develop clean, maintainable, and testable Java-based backend services and work across both the existing monolithic EBX environment and modern microservices architectures, such as Spring Boot.

Together with business stakeholders, you work in short iterations on improvements and new functionalities. The team has a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and ownership.
